arxiv-1806-01350.title: Trigger and Timing Distributions using the TTC-PON and GBT Bridge Connection in ALICE for the LHC Run 3 Upgrade
arxiv-1806-01350.creator: Jubin Mitra, Erno David, Eduardo Mendez, Shuaib Ahmad Khan, Tivadar Kiss, Sophie Baron, Alex Kluge, Tapan Nayak
arxiv-1806-01350.description: Abstract The ALICE experiment at CERN is preparing for a major upgrade for the third phase of data taking run (Run 3 ), when the high luminosity phase of the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) starts. The increase in the beam luminosity will result in high interaction rate causing the data acquisition rate to exceed 3 3 TB/sec.

arxiv-1909-06722.title: Plackett-Luce Model for Learning-to-Rank Task
arxiv-1909-06722.creator: Tian Xia, Shaodan Zhai, Shaojun Wang
arxiv-1909-06722.description: Abstract Résumé List-wise based learning to rank methods are generally supposed to have better performance than point- and pair-wise based. However, in real-world applications, state-of-the-art systems are not from list-wise based camp. In this paper, we propose a new non-linear algorithm in the list-wise based framework called ListMLE, which uses the Plackett-Luce (PL) loss.

arxiv-2105-06499.title: Improved Algorithms for Agnostic Pool-based Active Classification
arxiv-2105-06499.creator: Julian Katz-Samuels, Jifan Zhang, Lalit Jain, Kevin Jamieson
arxiv-2105-06499.description: Abstract We consider active learning for binary classification in the agnostic pool-based setting. The vast majority of works in active learning in the agnostic setting are inspired by the CAL algorithm where each query is uniformly sampled from the disagreement region of the current version space.

arxiv-2110-01294.title: K K - and D ( s ) D_{(s)} -meson leptonic decay constants with physical light, strange and charm quarks by ETMC
arxiv-2110-01294.creator: S. Simula
arxiv-2110-01294.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by S. Simula. We present a lattice QCD computation and preliminary results for the leptonic decay constants of the pseudoscalar mesons K K , D D and D s D_{s} in the isosymmetric QCD limit. The computation is based on simulations of N f = 2 + 1 + 1 N_{f}=2+1+1 dynamical quarks performed by the Extended Twisted Mass Collaboration (ETMC), where the light, strange and charm quark masses are all tuned at their physical values.

arxiv-2205-14235.title: Freezing Sets for Arbitrary Digital Dimension
arxiv-2205-14235.creator: Laurence Boxer
arxiv-2205-14235.description: Abstract We show how to obtain freezing sets for digital images in ℤ n \mathbb{Z}^{n} for arbitrary n n , using the c 1 c_{1} and c n c_{n} adjacencies. 1 Introduction The study of freezing sets is part of the fixed point theory of digital topology.

arxiv-2401-12248.title: A multiple-circuit approach to quantum resource reduction with application to the quantum lattice Boltzmann method
arxiv-2401-12248.creator: Melody Lee, Zhixin Song, Sriharsha Kocherla, Austin Adams, Alexander Alexeev, Spencer H. Bryngelson
arxiv-2401-12248.description: Abstract This work proposes a multi-circuit quantum lattice Boltzmann method (QLBM) algorithm that leverages parallel quantum computing to reduce quantum resource requirements. Computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations often entail a large computational burden on classical computers. At present, these simulations can require up to trillions of grid points and millions of time steps.

arxiv-2401-17975.title: Understanding polysemanticity in neural networks through coding theory Thanks: Work done outside of OpenAI.
arxiv-2401-17975.creator: Simon C. Marshall, Jan H. Kirchner
arxiv-2401-17975.description: Abstract Despite substantial efforts, neural network interpretability remains an elusive goal, with previous research failing to provide succinct explanations of most single neurons’ impact on the network output. This limitation is due to the polysemantic nature of most neurons, whereby a given neuron is involved in multiple unrelated network states, complicating the interpretation of that neuron.

arxiv-2409-05363.title: SINGULARITY FORMED BY THE COLLISION OF TWO COLLAPSING SOLITONS in interaction FOR THE 2D KELLER-SEGEL SYSTEM
arxiv-2409-05363.creator: Charles Collot, Tej-Eddine Ghoul, Nader Masmoudi, Van Tien Nguyen
arxiv-2409-05363.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Charles Collot, Tej-Eddine Ghoul, Nader Masmoudi, Van Tien Nguyen. It is well-known that the two-dimensional parabolic-elliptic Keller-Segel system admits finite-time blowup solutions, which is the case if the initial density has total mass greater than 8 ​ π 8\pi . Several constructive examples of such solutions have been given, where for all of them a perturbed stationary state undergoes scale instability and collapses at a point, resulting in an 8 ​ π 8\pi -mass concentration.

arxiv-2502-18028.title: Peculiar rainbows in Saturn’s E ring: Uncovering luminous bands near Enceladus
arxiv-2502-18028.creator: Niels Rubbrecht, Stéphanie Cazaux, Benoît Seignovert, Matthew Kenworthy, Nicholas Kutsop, Stéphane Le Mouélic, Jérôme Loicq
arxiv-2502-18028.description: Abstract We report observations of stripe-like features in Enceladus’ plumes captured simultaneously by Cassini’s VIMS-IR and ISS NAC instruments during flyby E17, with similar patterns seen in VIMS-IR data from flyby E13 and E19. These parallel stripes, inclined at approximately 16° to the ecliptic and 43° to Saturn’s ring plane, appear continuous across images when projected in the J2000 frame.

arxiv-2503-04345.title: Capillary jet in a slab of foam
arxiv-2503-04345.creator: Théophile Gaichies, Bryan Giraud, Emmanuelle Rio, Anniina Salonen, Arnaud Antkowiak
arxiv-2503-04345.description: Abstract A capillary jet plunging into a quasi-2D slab of monodisperse foam of the same solution is studied experimentally. We show that the jet can have a drastic impact on the foam. At small speeds it inflates the channels separating the bubbles. At intermediate speeds, impact with channels creates very small bubbles.

arxiv-2507-03700.title: Exponentially Fading Memory Signature
arxiv-2507-03700.creator: Eduardo Abi Jaber, Dimitri Sotnikov
arxiv-2507-03700.description: Abstract We introduce the exponentially fading memory (EFM) signature, a time-invariant transformation of an infinite (possibly rough) path that serves as a mean-reverting analogue of the classical path signature. We construct the EFM-signature via rough path theory, carefully adapted to accommodate improper integration from minus infinity.

arxiv-2510-16290.title: Cerberus: Real-Time Video Anomaly Detection via Cascaded Vision-Language Models Thanks: † Corresponding author: Yuanchao Shu (ycshu@zju.edu.cn).
arxiv-2510-16290.creator: Yue Zheng 1 , Xiufang Shi 1 , Jiming Chen 2, 3 , Yuanchao Shu 2,†
arxiv-2510-16290.description: Abstract . Video anomaly detection (VAD) has rapidly advanced by recent development of Vision-Language Models (VLMs). While these models offer superior zero-shot detection capabilities, their immense computational cost and unstable visual grounding performance hinder real-time deployment. To overcome these challenges, we introduce Cerberus , a two-stage cascaded system designed for efficient yet accurate real-time VAD.

arxiv-2511-05017.title: Towards Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models by Refining Textual Embeddings
arxiv-2511-05017.creator: Aakriti Agrawal 1 , Gouthaman KV 2 , Rohith Aralikatti 3 , Gauri Jagatap 2 , Jiaxin Yuan 1 , Vijay Kamarshi 2 , Andrea Fanelli 2 , Furong Huang 1,4 Correspondence: agrawal5@umd.edu
arxiv-2511-05017.description: Abstract Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) remain a persistent challenge, often stemming from inadequate integration of visual information during multimodal reasoning. A key cause is the model’s over-reliance on textual priors and underutilization of visual cues, leading to outputs that are linguistically fluent but visually inaccurate.

arxiv-2601-20917.title: FIPS 204-Compatible Threshold ML-DSA via Masked Lagrange Reconstruction
arxiv-2601-20917.description: Abstract We present masked Lagrange reconstruction , a technique that enables threshold ML-DSA (FIPS 204) with arbitrary thresholds T T while producing standard 3.3 KB signatures verifiable by unmodified FIPS 204 implementations. Concurrent approaches have limitations: Bienstock et al. (ePrint 2025/1163) achieve arbitrary T T but require honest-majority and 37–136 rounds; Celi et al.

pmc-12513896.title: A web-based mouse-tracking task for early perceptual language processing
pmc-12513896.creator: Holger Mitterer
pmc-12513896.description: The study of language processing requires data from a wide range of languages but also data that are free from demand characteristics and meta-linguistic strategies. While eye-tracking has been successfully used to address the later issue, pragmatically, eye-tracking is often difficult to achieve with less well-studied languages.

pmc-12598134.title: Interference of Intravenous Acetaminophen with Continuous Glucose Monitoring System
pmc-12598134.creator: Misayo Matsuyama, Satoru Meiri, Hirotake Sawada, Ryuta Masuya, Kazuhiko Nakame, Hiroshi Moritake
pmc-12598134.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Sensor-augmented pumps (SAPs) and automated insulin delivery (AID) systems are innovative technologies for diabetes management. Accurate continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) is crucial for their safe and effective use; however, certain commonly used drugs can interfere with CGM accuracy. Although acetaminophen is known to cause falsely elevated CGM glucose values, previous CGM studies have primarily focused on its oral administration, with limited data on intravenous use.

pmc-12682323.title: A Novel Niosomal Doxycycline/Triamcinolone Medicament Matches Calcium Hydroxide for Low Tooth Staining: A 4-Week in Vitro Study
pmc-12682323.creator: Rahim Fereidooni, Arash Shahravan, Hamed Manochehrifar, Abbas Pardakhty, Homa Kamyabi, Amir Hossein Nekouei
pmc-12682323.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Introduction:Tooth discoloration remains a significant concern in endodontic treatment, particularly with the use of intracanal medicaments. This study investigated the discoloration potential of niosomal doxycycline and triamcinolone, a novel nanotechnology-based drug delivery system, in comparison to conventional medications. Materials and Methods:Fifty extracted single-rooted human teeth were assigned to five groups: (1) calcium hydroxide, (2) calcium hydroxide+triamcinolone, (3) niosomal doxycycline+triamcinolone, (4) doxycycline+triamcinolone, and control groups (positive: blood; negative: saline).

pmc-12983695.title: The ‘golden hour’: a geospatial analysis of travel time to public emergency departments in Kenya
pmc-12983695.creator: Tushara Surapaneni, Nancy Gakii Kinyua, Benjamin W Wachira
pmc-12983695.description: IntroductionIn Kenya and many other low- and middle-income countries, prehospital care systems are underdeveloped or entirely non-existent, leaving emergency departments (EDs) as the primary point of care for medical emergencies. The aim of this cross-sectional observational study was to use a geographic information system (GIS) to comprehensively analyse access to public EDs in Kenya within 1-hour and 2-hour travel times.

pmc-13393635.title: Brazilian guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of candidemia and invasive candidiasis in adults and children
pmc-13393635.creator: Arnaldo L Colombo, Marcello MC Magri, Fabianne Carlesse, Diego R Falci, Marcia Garnica, Daniel WCL Santos, Flavio Queiroz-Telles, Alessandro C Pasqualotto
pmc-13393635.description: BackgroundInvasive candidiasis, including candidemia and deep-seated Candida infections, remains a major cause of morbidity and mortality in hospitalized patients worldwide, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. In Brazil, candidemia is associated with persistently high mortality rates, driven by late diagnosis, limited access to antifungal agents, and heterogeneous diagnostic capacity.

pmc-13570450.title: Large Uterine Angiolipoleiomyoma Masquerading as an Ovarian Tumor: A Case Report
pmc-13570450.creator: Prabineshwor Prasad Lekhak, Smriti Basnet, Hari Narayan Rai, Palistha Shakya, Tulsi Raj Khanal, Jyotsna Sharma Tiwari, Roshan Ghimire, Semonti Nandi
pmc-13570450.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Angiolipoleiomyoma (ALLM) is a rare benign mesenchymal tumor that primarily arises in the skin and kidney, and less frequently in the uterus. The present case may represent the largest reported uterine mass described as ALLM. We present a case of a 52‐year‐old woman with abdominal fullness and an irregular menstrual cycle having a large cystic abdominopelvic mass initially masquerading as a large ovarian tumor. Following successful tumor resection and subsequent histopathological and immunohistochemical analysis, a definitive diagnosis of uterine ALLM was established.

pmc-13576544.title: Effects of Algae β‐Glucan Supplementation on the Performance and Intestinal Immune System of Healthy Weaned Piglets
pmc-13576544.creator: Johanna O Buckenberger, Felizitas Gutöhrlein, Manfred Henrich, Erika Most, Rose Whelan, John K Htoo, Robert Ringseis, Klaus Eder
pmc-13576544.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). While β‐glucans from plants and yeasts have been extensively studied in weaned piglets, studies examining algae β‐glucans are scarce. Thus, the present study aimed to examine the effects of feeding algae β‐glucan in weaned piglets. Male, 21‐day‐old, weaned crossbred piglets were allotted to three experimental groups, which were fed either an adequate basal diet (Control) or the basal diet supplemented with 100 (A100) or 200 g/t (A200) of algae β‐glucan for 35 days.
